LESSON: READING 15.4.1 POEMS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Reading 15.4.1 Poems

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 15.4.1 Poems. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which lessons have you learnt from poems before?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the ideas in the Poems
2. recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: READING 15.4.1 POEMS
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Reading 15.4.1 Poems helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: READING 15.4.1 POEMS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify the ideas in the Poems

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the ideas in the Poems. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the ideas in the Poems.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Reading 15.4.1 Poems”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the ideas in the Poems. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues

What this means
In this part you learn to recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading 15.4.1 Poems to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Reading 15.4.1 Poems is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Reading 15.4.1 Poems”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify the ideas in the Poems)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading 15.4.1 Poems to a partner. (skill: recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Reading 15.4.1 Poems to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the ideas in the Poems.
3. Practise this skill: recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Reading 15.4.1 Poems from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Reading 15.4.1 Poems: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Reading 15.4.1 Poems?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which lessons have you learnt from poems before?
2. How can you say what is in the poem in your own words?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Reading 15.4.1 Poems means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the ideas in the Poems.
5. Be able to: recognise the role of poems in addressing societal issues.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
